title: Spectral Energy Transfer Lab
description: A mystical laboratory where a translucent dragon and a subsurface-scattering skull face each other on pedestals. The user manipulates a shared pool of spectral energy between them, adjusting material properties like transmission, thickness, attenuation color, and scattering coefficients. Energy is conserved: increasing one model's material intensity decreases the other's, and all changes support full undo/redo.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls. Load DragonAttenuation.glb on the left and ScatteringSkull.glb on the right, placed on circular pedestals 4 units apart. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0,2,7) looking at origin. Add an HDR-style environment using PMREMGenerator with a procedural sky-like scene for reflections, plus a warm DirectionalLight and soft AmbientLight. Both models must use MeshPhysicalMaterial. Implement a shared energy pool of 100 units displayed as a bar at the top of the screen. Create an HTML control panel with these coupled sliders: (1) Dragon Transmission vs Skull Scattering balance slider — moving energy to dragon transmission removes from skull scattering intensity. (2) Attenuation Distance slider for dragon (1-20 range) that inversely affects skull thickness. (3) Attenuation Color picker for dragon that sets the complementary color as skull scattering color. (4) IOR slider (1.0-2.5) shared between both models. (5) A global Energy Intensity slider (0-100) that scales all material properties proportionally. Conservation law: the sum of dragon transmission + skull scattering coefficients must always equal 1.0. When any slider changes, recompute all coupled values and update both materials in real-time. Implement a full undo/redo system: store material state snapshots in a history stack (max 50 entries) on every slider release. Add Undo (Ctrl+Z) and Redo (Ctrl+Y) buttons and keyboard shortcuts that restore all slider positions and material states. Add a Reset button that returns to default state and clears history. Display current material property values for both models in a floating info panel. Both models should slowly rotate on their pedestals (opposite directions). The pedestals should have emissive rings whose color reflects the dominant energy allocation. Total interaction steps: adjust 5 sliders, use color picker, test undo twice, redo once, reset once, re-adjust twice = ~12 steps.
